title: AI Participatory - Open City Poblenou
description: Academic work exploring participatory design using n8n, ComfyUI and vision-language models. Trained models to sketch like humans and used GPT-4o + Roboflow vision models to power an AI-assisted participatory design process.

title: Heat Archipelagos
description: Academic work at IAAC studying urban heat across 105 cities, clustering them into an 'archipelago' model via unsupervised machine learning, built with Grasshopper, Google Earth Engine and Python.

title: Rundu Mobility Justice Framework
description: Studies urban vulnerability and injustice in Ndama, a small settlement in Rundu, through the lens of mobility. Built a website compiling collected data and used NLP/LLM-weighted GNN clustering of stakeholder input for urban planners and government officials.

title: Wildfire Vulnerability
description: A forensic approach to spatial wildfire data using Roboflow and Google Earth Engine. Published a global GEE dataset correlating NDVI-NDMI over six months and mapping fire stations/hospitals able to respond to an outbreak.

title: GV1 Chemical Campus
description: A chemical campus constructed between metal fins, creating the impression that the building is held together by metal membranes. The atrium detailing features a continuous glass frame transitioning seamlessly from facade to roof structure.

title: Koya Cube
description: Freelance project for a fabrication company in Germany. A Grasshopper + Python script generates a parametric module from user-input sizes, uploads it to ShapeDiver for visualization, then outputs fabrication codes and sizes.

title: Capella School District
description: A master plan for a hybrid school district, staged using generative site planning with the Termite nest plugin for Grasshopper and basic algorithmic computation.

title: DNL
description: A corporate campus articulated with large volumes and intricate detailing, blending materials and local climate response.
